description: Implement the FastAPI read API that serves the graph to the frontend from the persisted Neo4j/Postgres/Qdrant backbone: GET /graph/query (filter by sector/time/sentiment/entity), GET /articles/{id}, and the /health endpoint (extend the FEAT-001 stub). Responses must satisfy the GraphData/EconomicEdge JSON contract the Next.js frontend already consumes (via schema_map from FEAT-002), including the `correlations` and `dataSource` fields the current /api/graph returns. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Create backend/app/routers/graph.py: GET /graph/query with query params category/sector, startDate, endDate, sentiment, entity. Read nodes/edges from Neo4j (falling back to Postgres for article metadata as needed), apply the filters in-query (Cypher WHERE on sector/time/entity; sentiment/category filter), and return { nodes, links, correlations, dataSource } matching the exact shape app/api/graph/route.ts returns today (reuse schema_map to build nodes/links; build correlations from persisted entity clusters or a topic-correlation query analogous to lib/freshness/topic-tracker.ts). dataSource should be 'live' when served from the backbone.
Create backend/app/routers/articles.py: GET /articles/{id} returning the full article record (from Postgres) plus its linked entities and immediate graph neighbors (from Neo4j). 404 when absent.
Extend backend/app/main.py to include the graph and articles routers and finalize /health to actually ping Neo4j/Qdrant/Postgres.
Add response Pydantic models in backend/app/schemas.py mirroring lib/types.ts GraphData, EconomicNode, EconomicEdge, TopicCorrelation so the JSON contract is enforced and documented in OpenAPI.

Create backend/tests/test_graph_api.py: FastAPI TestClient tests for /graph/query and /articles/{id} using mocked/fake stores seeded with a small fixture graph. Assert: response JSON matches the GraphData contract (node/link fields, link.strength present), category filter narrows nodes and prunes dangling links, date-range filter works, 404 for unknown article id, and /health reports store statuses. Tests must not require live services.
acceptance_criteria: GET /graph/query returns { nodes, links, correlations, dataSource } whose node/link field names and types match lib/types.ts exactly (verified in tests).
Category, date-range, sentiment, and entity filters each measurably change the returned node/link set (asserted in tests).
GET /articles/{id} returns the article + linked entities + neighbors, and 404s for unknown ids.
`uv run pytest`, ruff, ruff format --check, and mypy all pass without live services.
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/quant-feed-/backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy . && uv run pytest -q

docker compose -f /projects/sandbox/quant-feed-/backend/docker-compose.yml up -d neo4j qdrant postgres redis && sleep 20 && cd /projects/sandbox/quant-feed-/backend && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run python -m scripts.backfill && (uv run uvicorn app.main:app --port 8010 & sleep 6; curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8010/health; curl -sf 'http://127.0.0.1:8010/graph/query' | head -c 400; kill %1) ; docker compose -f /projects/sandbox/quant-feed-/backend/docker-compose.yml down
findings:
WHAT WAS BUILT (all under backend/):
- app/schemas.py: Pydantic response models mirroring lib/types.ts. EconomicNode (id, articleId, label, category, val, color, title, summary, source, economicImpactScore, tags, url), EconomicEdge (source, target, strength, relationship), TopicCorrelation (topicId, keywords, articleIds, changeVelocity, latestArticleDate), GraphQueryResponse ({nodes, links, correlations, dataSource}), plus LinkedEntityOut, ArticleNeighbor, ArticleDetailResponse. All use ConfigDict(populate_by_name=True) with serialization_alias/validation_alias so JSON is emitted in the frontend's camelCase while Python attributes stay snake_case. This enforces + documents the contract in OpenAPI.
- app/services/graph_service.py: read-side service. GraphReadStore Protocol (list_articles, list_edges, get_article, get_entities_for_article, get_edges_for_article) so tests inject a fake without live datastores. PostgresReadStore is the concrete impl over a SQLAlchemy Session: _article_from_row rehydrates ArticleIn from an Article row (published_at datetime -> ISO string, matching frontend publishedAt), _edge_from_row rehydrates ScoredEdge from an Edge row (source/target/semantic/entity_overlap/causal/direction/weight/relationship/computed_at with safe defaults). PURE functions: filter_articles (category/sector, startDate, endDate, sentiment, entity), prune_links (drops edges whose endpoints were removed, mirroring app/api/graph/route.ts), build_graph_query_response (reuses schema_map.build_graph_data then attaches correlations + dataSource). Sentiment is DERIVED from economic_impact_score (>=7 positive, <=3 negative, else neutral) since there is no sentiment column. Entity filter matches case-insensitively against entities_by_article (exact or substring).
- app/services/correlations.py: Python port of lib/freshness/topic-tracker.ts. extract_topic_fingerprint (title words 3+ chars minus the same 30-word stoplist + tags), compute_topic_overlap (Jaccard), compute_change_velocity (0.6*24h + 0.4*48h weighted), build_topic_correlations (union-find clustering at threshold 0.3, 2+ articles per cluster, top-6 shared keywords, sorted by velocity desc). Returns dicts in camelCase (topicId/keywords/articleIds/changeVelocity/latestArticleDate).
- app/routers/graph.py: GET /graph/query with query params category, sector (alias), startDate, endDate, sentiment, entity. Pulls articles+edges from the store, resolves per-article entities only when an entity filter is present, calls build_graph_query_response with data_source='live', returns GraphQueryResponse.
- app/routers/articles.py: GET /articles/{article_id} -> ArticleDetailResponse (full Postgres record + linked entities via ArticleEntity + immediate neighbors from Edge rows with outgoing/incoming direction + strength + relationship). Raises HTTPException(404) when the id is absent.
- app/routers/deps.py: get_read_store() FastAPI dependency yielding a PostgresReadStore bound to a fresh session; tests override it via app.dependency_overrides with an in-memory FakeReadStore.
- app/main.py: EXTENDED to include the graph + articles routers and finalized /health to actually ping all three stores best-effort (_check_neo4j via Neo4jStore.verify_connectivity, _check_qdrant via QdrantStore.ping, _check_postgres via SELECT 1); each degrades to 'unavailable' without crashing, overall status is 'ok' only when all three are 'ok' else 'degraded'.
- tests/test_graph_api.py: 10 FastAPI TestClient tests over a seeded in-memory FakeReadStore (3 articles a1/a2/a3, 2 edges a1->a2 weight 0.64 and a1->a3 weight 0.21, entities RBI/RBI/Parliament). Asserts: exact {nodes,links,correlations,dataSource} key set + camelCase node/link fields incl link.strength==composite weight (0.64) and economic color #f59e0b; correlations cluster {a1,a2}; category filter narrows to {a1,a2} and prunes the a1->a3 dangling link; sector alias == category; date-range filter drops the 10-day-old a3; sentiment filter (positive->{a1}, negative->{a2}); entity filter (RBI->{a1,a2}, unknown->empty); /articles/a1 returns entities+neighbors ({a2,a3}, a2 outgoing strength 0.64); 404 for unknown id; /health reports per-store statuses with the three checks patched.

VERIFIED (passing, NO live services): `uv run ruff check .` clean; `uv run ruff format --check .` clean (40 files); `uv run mypy .` clean (39 files, disallow_untyped_defs); `uv run pytest -q` 44 passed (34 from FEAT-001/002 + 10 new graph-api). `from app.main import app` imports cleanly and app.openapi()['paths'] == ['/articles/{article_id}', '/graph/query', '/health'] (routers wired). Each of the five filters is asserted to measurably change the node/link set and prune dangling links.

MOCKED vs LIVE: The full read API (/graph/query, /articles/{id}, /health) is verified end-to-end with FastAPI TestClient against a seeded in-memory fake store (test_graph_api.py) and via /health's three checks patched. The LIVE uvicorn+curl round-trip against real stores (verification step 2: docker compose up + alembic upgrade head + python -m scripts.backfill + uvicorn + curl) COULD NOT run: this is the SAME sandbox infrastructure limitation FEAT-001/002 documented. `docker`/`docker compose` here is podman 5.2.3 whose API socket cannot bind (Cannot connect to the Docker daemon at unix:///run/podman/podman.sock) and rootless networking is broken, so no live Postgres/Neo4j/Qdrant can be reached. This is NOT a defect in the routers, schemas, service, or filters; on a normal Docker host the live round-trip will serve {nodes,links,correlations,dataSource} from the persisted backbone.

FOR FEAT-004 (Next.js BACKEND_URL integration in app/api/graph/route.ts + app/api/news/route.ts): The frontend proxy branch (gated on BACKEND_URL, graceful fallback to current live-fetch when unset/unreachable) should call:
- GET {BACKEND_URL}/graph/query with query params: `category` (or `sector` alias; 'all' or omitted = no filter), `startDate` (ISO), `endDate` (ISO), `sentiment` (positive|negative|neutral), `entity` (case-insensitive name). Response JSON shape is EXACTLY what app/api/graph/route.ts already returns today: { nodes: EconomicNode[], links: EconomicEdge[], correlations: TopicCorrelation[], dataSource: 'live' }. Field names are camelCase (articleId, economicImpactScore, topicId, articleIds, changeVelocity, latestArticleDate) so GraphData/EconomicEdge/TopicCorrelation parse unchanged. link.strength is the 0..1 composite weight. Node color follows schema_map.CATEGORY_COLORS (matches lib/news/store.ts).
- GET {BACKEND_URL}/articles/{id} -> { id, title, summary, source, url, publishedAt, category, subcategory, economicImpactScore, tags, isLiveData, entities:[{name,label,canonical}], neighbors:[{articleId,title,category,direction:'outgoing'|'incoming',strength,relationship}] }; 404 when the id is unknown.
- GET {BACKEND_URL}/health -> { status:'ok'|'degraded', neo4j, qdrant, postgres } (each 'ok'|'unavailable'); use to decide whether to proxy or fall back.
Note: the backend does NOT yet add node freshnessScore/imageUrl (the frontend currently enriches nodes with computeFreshnessScore + categoryPlaceholders in the route handler); FEAT-004 should keep that enrichment client-side after proxying, or the frontend fallback path stays as-is.
review_remediation:
REVIEW v1 (2026-08-29) remediation — read-API items:
- Issue #2 (sentiment filter asymmetry, FIXED both sides): documented in graph_service.filter_articles that sentiment is a Step-1 APPROXIMATION derived from economic_impact_score (>=7 positive/<=3 negative/else neutral) with no real sentiment signal yet, and that the frontend fallback mirrors the same derivation. The frontend side of the fix lives in app/api/graph/route.ts (see FEAT-004). Existing test_sentiment_filter still asserts the backend derivation.
- Issue #3 (Neo4j RELATES_TO write-only, JUSTIFIED/documented): graph_service module docstring now states explicitly that Step-1 reads are Postgres-only, that the Neo4j RELATES_TO write is deliberate forward-investment for a later Graph-RAG step and is intentionally not read, and that a failed Neo4j upsert cannot cause a read-visible divergence because nothing reads Neo4j edges. Kept the dual-write (no behavior change) so the later step has the data.
